name: AIGC-Blur-Benchmark
description: AIGC-Blur-Benchmark measures model performance on detecting and handling blurred images (often AI-generated) and assessing image quality under varying blur conditions. It is intended to evaluate robustness of vision models to blur and to benchmark systems that classify or score image blur severity.
reputation: A small, specialized dataset hosted on Hugging Face for evaluating blur in AI-generated images with limited community adoption to date.
